mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates economic expansion, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) below the 12-month moving average signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST falls below its 12-month moving average and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it indicates a tight labor market and restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals increased economic activity, boosting investor sentiment and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises above its 6-month moving average and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below the 3-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS falls below its 3-month moving average and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and housing starts (HOUST) are declining, it indicates a broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and HOUST < 3-month moving average
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth is below 2% and HOUST is declining, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
